text: Old Wren keeps the post office, the island’s letters, and every story nobody wants told.
Gus drew the four marks in the dust. She did not look at them for long.
The man who sold his shadow. He paid with four marks, one for each year the sea let him live.
Three he carved on his door. The fourth was never drawn, Gus. It was burned.
Then she closed the shutters, which she never does before the lamp comes on.
That night, for the first time in a hundred years, the lamp did not come on at all.
